name: Mip-NeRF Optimization and Activation Details
definition: A set of implementation details for training mip-NeRF and JaxNeRF, including activation functions, identity concatenation removal, and learning rate scheduling, designed to improve training stability and robustness without significantly changing accuracy or speed.
summary: Mip-NeRF Optimization and Activation Details defines training hyperparameters and specific activation functions, such as shifted softplus and widened sigmoid, to ensure optimization stability and prevent catastrophic failure modes.
